description: Records mono or stereo audio, or the Rack window as video, to a file on disk

params.text: Gain applied to the signal before it is written, from silence to +12dB
Click to start recording and click again to stop; if no output file has been chosen a file dialog opens first

inputs.text: Recording runs while the gate here is high and stops when it falls, which gives one file per gate
Each trigger here switches recording on, and the next one switches it off
The left channel of the recording, and the whole of it when RIGHT has no cable
The right channel of the recording; a cable here makes the file stereo instead of mono

notes: the meter shows the level going in, and a red light means the audio is clipping, so lower the gain
nothing is written until an output file has been chosen and recording has been switched on, by the button on the panel or by a gate or trigger
the file and the format can be changed only while recording is stopped
menu: Output file — the heading over the file the recording is written to, printing the path now set
Select... — opens a file dialogue for choosing the file written to
Append -001, -002, etc. — numbers each new file rather than overwriting the last recording
Audio formats — the heading over WAV, AIFF, FLAC, ALAC, MP3 and Opus, each printed with the file extension it writes
Video formats — the heading over H.264, MPEG-2 video, FFV1 (lossless) and HuffYUV (lossless), which record the Rack window instead of audio
Encoder settings — the heading over what the chosen format can be set to
Sample rate — sets the sample rate the file is written at, in kHz
Bit depth — sets how many bits each sample is written with, and a compressed format offers a bit rate in kbps in its place
